chunks: So, you should not entertain any doubt about those whom they worship: They only worship what their fathers had worshipped before them. We shall verily give them their meed without diminution.
ai.seo_question: Why do polytheists worship idols according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Hud reassures the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that the polytheists' idolatry is rooted in blind imitation of their ancestors, a theme central to Shia critiques of taqlid (uncritical following). It emphasizes divine justice, noting that God will fully repay them for their deeds without diminution, highlighting the certainty of the Hereafter. This serves as both a comfort to the Prophet and a warning to those who cling to ancestral traditions over divine truth.
